reason: The cited evidence shows that disorder and electron count are both relevant parameters (E3), but none of the passages demonstrate independent tuning of configurational entropy while holding electron count constant, nor do they provide evidence that higher entropy enhances electron-phonon coupling or reduces scattering. The claims about the mechanism and the predicted systematic trends are therefore unsupported by the provided prior work.
premises: Configurational disorder (mixing entropy) can be tuned independently of average valence electron count
Higher configurational entropy enhances electron-phonon coupling and Cooper pairing
Higher configurational entropy minimizes detrimental pair-breaking scattering
A homogeneous but disordered BCC lattice stabilizes a robust superconducting state
Tc and critical fields increase systematically with configurational entropy
